title: DR reflection plan: navigation layer (24 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the navigation layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

operations.rationale: Remove navigation.route.associated-with.navigation.routemeta: navigation.route.composes.navigation.routemeta already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.53; claims rel:navigation.route#1.

evidence.quote: The relationships navigation.route associated-with navigation.routemeta and navigation.route composes navigation.routemeta express the same meaning and are redundant. Proposed: Remove associated-with and keep composes between navigation.route and navigation.routemeta.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.route#1): best source of 'associated-with navigation.routemeta': navigation.route (0.80), none (0.13), navigation.navigationgraph (0.02); best destination of 'navigation.route associated-with': navigation.routemeta (0.75), none (0.16), navigation.breadcrumbconfig (0.02); best predicate: composes (0.53), reverse:serves (0.25), references (0.06). Outcome: alternative (predicate=composes).

operations.rationale: Rename the predicate of navigation.navigationgraph.composes.navigation.route to navigation.navigationgraph.aggregates.navigation.route. Plan kind rename-predicate, p 0.55; claims rel:navigation.navigationgraph#1.

evidence.quote: navigation.navigationgraph has both aggregates and composes relationships to navigation.route, which gives contradictory lifecycle semantics for the same pair. Proposed: Keep only the composes relationship from navigationgraph to route and remove the aggregates relationship.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.navigationgraph#1): best source of 'composes navigation.route': navigation.navigationgraph (0.70), navigation.navigationflow (0.12), none (0.06); best destination of 'navigation.navigationgraph composes': navigation.route (0.66), navigation.navigationtransition (0.14), none (0.10); best predicate: aggregates (0.55), composes (0.28), references (0.07). Outcome: alternative (predicate=aggregates).

operations.rationale: Rename the predicate of navigation.breadcrumbconfig.provides.navigation.routemeta to navigation.breadcrumbconfig.uses.navigation.routemeta. Plan kind rename-predicate, p 0.43; claims rel:navigation.breadcrumbconfig#1.

evidence.quote: The relationship navigation.breadcrumbconfig provides navigation.routemeta appears inverted, because RouteMeta normally supplies the breadcrumb label that BreadcrumbConfig consumes. Proposed: Reverse the relationship so RouteMeta provides to BreadcrumbConfig, or replace it with a consumes/reads-from relationship from BreadcrumbConfig to RouteMeta.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.breadcrumbconfig#1): best source of 'provides navigation.routemeta': none (0.48), navigation.breadcrumbconfig (0.22), navigation.navigationgraph (0.12); best destination of 'navigation.breadcrumbconfig provides': navigation.routemeta (0.40), none (0.33), navigation.navigationgraph (0.14); best predicate: uses (0.43), references (0.16), depends-on (0.15). Outcome: alternative (predicate=uses).

operations.rationale: Rename the predicate of navigation.navigationguard.requires.security.role to navigation.navigationguard.references.security.role. Plan kind rename-predicate, p 0.35; claims rel:navigation.navigationguard#4.

evidence.quote: The requires relationship from navigation.navigationguard to security.role overlaps with the references relationship to business.businessrole. Proposed: Clarify the boundary between the two role relationships or merge them.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.navigationguard#4): best source of 'requires security.role': navigation.navigationguard (0.70), navigation.guardcondition (0.12), none (0.05); best destination of 'navigation.navigationguard requires': security.role (0.73), security.actor (0.10), none (0.09); best predicate: references (0.35), requires (0.22), uses (0.21). Outcome: alternative (predicate=references).

operations.rationale: Remove navigation.flowstep.realizes.business.businessfunction: navigation.flowstep.realizes.product.workflowstep already exists and expresses it. Plan kind retarget, p 0.68; claims rel:navigation.flowstep#5.

evidence.quote: The relationship navigation.flowstep realizes business.businessfunction is weak because a flow step is ordered while business functions are unordered. Proposed: Remove the realizes relationship from FlowStep to BusinessFunction.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.flowstep#5): best source of 'realizes business.businessfunction': navigation.flowstep (0.71), none (0.11), application.applicationfunction (0.07); best destination of 'navigation.flowstep realizes': product.workflowstep (0.68), navigation.route (0.09), none (0.09); best predicate: none (0.46), realizes (0.27), references (0.06). Outcome: alternative (target=product.workflowstep).

evidence.quote: The relationship navigation.flowstep maps-to ux.view is a data-mapping predicate and duplicates the Route to View rendering relationship. Proposed: Remove the maps-to relationship from FlowStep to View.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.flowstep#2): best source of 'maps-to ux.view': navigation.route (0.65), none (0.18), navigation.flowstep (0.08); best destination of 'navigation.flowstep maps-to': none (0.52), ux.view (0.39), ux.componentreference (0.02); best predicate: none (0.51), references (0.17), realizes (0.10). operations.rationale: Retarget of navigation.guardcondition.constrains.navigation.route to navigation.navigationguard.constrains.navigation.route. Plan kind retarget, p 0.65; claims node:navigation.guardcondition#2.

evidence.quote: The 'constrains' relationship from navigation.guardcondition to navigation.route duplicates the role already played by the guard. Proposed: Remove the constrains relationship from guardcondition to route.

Sorting answers (node:navigation.guardcondition#2): best source of 'constrains navigation.route': navigation.navigationguard (0.64), navigation.guardcondition (0.18), none (0.06); best destination of 'navigation.guardcondition constrains': none (0.40), navigation.route (0.26), navigation.guardcondition (0.18); best predicate: none (0.57), constrains (0.23), references (0.07). Sorting answers (rel:navigation.route#6): best source of 'uses ux.layoutconfig': navigation.routemeta (0.62), ux.view (0.17), navigation.route (0.05); best destination of 'navigation.route uses': ux.layoutconfig (0.75), none (0.08), data-store.view (0.08); best predicate: uses (0.34), none (0.25), references (0.19). Outcome: alternative (source=navigation.routemeta).

evidence.quote: The accesses relationship from NavigationFlow to ux.view overlaps the existing step-to-route-to-view chain. Proposed: Remove the direct accesses relationship to ux.view and rely on the step-to-route-to-view chain.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.navigationflow#3): best source of 'accesses ux.view': navigation.flowstep (0.55), none (0.20), navigation.navigationflow (0.09); best destination of 'navigation.navigationflow accesses': none (0.39), ux.view (0.29), data-store.collection (0.10); best predicate: none (0.75), references (0.07), uses (0.05). operations.rationale: Retarget of navigation.navigationflow.satisfies.security.securityconstraints to navigation.navigationflow.satisfies.security.bindingofduty. Plan kind retarget, p 0.51; claims node:security.securityconstraints#4.

evidence.quote: Incoming 'satisfies' relationships from apm.logprocessor, navigationflow and objectschema target the security.securityconstraints container rather than individual rules, which weakens traceability. Proposed: Redirect these 'satisfies' relationships to the aggregated rule types (e.g. separationofduty, bindingofduty, needtoknow) instead of the container.

operations.rationale: Retarget of navigation.route.realizes.motivation.outcome to business.businessprocess.realizes.business.businessprocess. Plan kind retarget, p 0.47; claims rel:navigation.route#5.

evidence.quote: The relationship navigation.route realizes motivation.outcome uses a predicate that does not fit; supports-goals or delivers-value would be more appropriate. Proposed: Replace realizes with supports-goals or delivers-value.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.route#5): best source of 'realizes motivation.outcome': business.businessprocess (0.66), navigation.flowstep (0.13), navigation.route (0.11); best destination of 'navigation.route realizes': business.businessprocess (0.47), motivation.outcome (0.23), motivation.goal (0.12); best predicate: none (0.42), realizes (0.26), serves (0.19). Outcome: alternative (source=business.businessprocess; target=business.businessprocess).

operations.rationale: Retarget of navigation.navigationflow.flows-to.navigation.navigationtransition to navigation.flowstep.flows-to.navigation.navigationtransition. Plan kind retarget, p 0.47; claims rel:navigation.navigationflow#4.

evidence.quote: The flows-to predicate from NavigationFlow to NavigationTransition is odd, since a flow traverses or references transitions. Proposed: Change the predicate from flows-to to traverses or references.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.navigationflow#4): best source of 'flows-to navigation.navigationtransition': navigation.flowstep (0.46), navigation.navigationflow (0.19), navigation.navigationgraph (0.16); best destination of 'navigation.navigationflow flows-to': navigation.navigationtransition (0.43), none (0.26), navigation.flowstep (0.23); best predicate: none (0.30), references (0.25), uses (0.13). operations.rationale: Remove navigation.navigationtransition.triggers.navigation.guardaction: navigation.navigationguard.triggers.navigation.guardaction already exists and expresses it. Plan kind retarget, p 0.45; claims rel:navigation.navigationtransition#2.

evidence.quote: The relationship navigation.navigationtransition triggers navigation.guardaction is indirect, since the guard triggers its action on denial and the transition only causes it through requires NavigationGuard. Proposed: Remove the direct triggers relationship from navigationtransition to guardaction, relying on requires NavigationGuard instead.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.navigationtransition#2): best source of 'triggers navigation.guardaction': navigation.navigationguard (0.45), navigation.guardaction (0.26), none (0.13); best destination of 'navigation.navigationtransition triggers': navigation.guardaction (0.62), ux.statetransition (0.14), none (0.12); best predicate: none (0.71), depends-on (0.10), triggers (0.08). operations.rationale: Retarget of navigation.contextvariable.consumes.navigation.route to navigation.flowstep.consumes.navigation.route. Plan kind retarget, p 0.39; claims rel:navigation.contextvariable#1.

evidence.quote: The relationship navigation.contextvariable consumes navigation.route gives agent-like behavior to passive runtime data and its direction is wrong; the route should provide or populate the variable. Proposed: Invert it so navigation.route provides or populates navigation.contextvariable, or remove the consumes relationship from contextvariable to route.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.contextvariable#1): best source of 'consumes navigation.route': navigation.flowstep (0.39), navigation.navigationflow (0.18), none (0.14); best destination of 'navigation.contextvariable consumes': none (0.57), navigation.route (0.19), navigation.flowstep (0.14); best predicate: none (0.65), references (0.14), consumes (0.06). Outcome: alternative (source=navigation.flowstep).

evidence.quote: The triggers relationship from navigation.guardcondition to navigation.guardaction is loosely modeled, because the NavigationGuard invokes the guard action on denial and the guard condition itself does not. Proposed: none stated

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.guardcondition#2): best source of 'triggers navigation.guardaction': navigation.navigationguard (0.80), none (0.07), navigation.guardaction (0.03); best destination of 'navigation.guardcondition triggers': navigation.guardaction (0.46), navigation.navigationguard (0.36), none (0.11); best predicate: reverse:depends-on (0.64), none (0.19), triggers (0.07). operations.rationale: Change of navigation.guardaction.depends-on.navigation.guardcondition to navigation.guardcondition.triggers.navigation.navigationguard. Plan kind compound, p 0.43; claims rel:navigation.guardaction#1.

evidence.quote: The depends-on relationship from navigation.guardaction to navigation.guardcondition is indirect, because both attach to a NavigationGuard that evaluates the condition and then invokes the action, so it misrepresents the real dependency. Proposed: Remove or replace the direct GuardAction depends-on GuardCondition relationship with guard-level relationships mediated by NavigationGuard.

operations.rationale: Change of navigation.contextvariable.triggers.navigation.navigationtransition to navigation.navigationtransition.uses.navigation.flowstep. Plan kind compound, p 0.33; claims node:navigation.contextvariable#7, rel:navigation.contextvariable#2.

evidence.quote: A 'triggers' relationship from the passive navigation.contextvariable to navigation.navigationtransition is questionable because passive state does not trigger transitions. Proposed: Remove the triggers edge or replace it with a more fitting predicate or direction.

The relationship navigation.contextvariable triggers navigation.navigationtransition attributes active behavior to passive data; it would be better modeled as a guard evaluating the variable. Proposed: Replace the triggers relationship with a guard (guardcondition or navigationguard) that evaluates the context variable.

Sorting answers (rel:navigation.contextvariable#2): best source of 'triggers navigation.navigationtransition': navigation.flowstep (0.33), navigation.guardcondition (0.20), navigation.navigationflow (0.19); best destination of 'navigation.contextvariable triggers': navigation.navigationtransition (0.50), none (0.28), navigation.flowstep (0.09); best predicate: reverse:uses (0.79), none (0.10), triggers (0.03).
